nodes.description: Constant private uint256 MIN_VOTES = 4, quorum threshold used by vote().
Constant private uint256 LIQUIDATION_PERCENT = 20, percentage multiplier used to size the liquidation amount.
Private address payable splitter, hardcoded recipient of the whole contract balance in process().
Private address payable[] targets, fixed list of 12 voter addresses populated in the constructor.
Private mapping(address => bool) votes, per-address voting flag mutated by vote(), unvote() and _resetVotes().
Private address deployer, privileged address set to msg.sender in the constructor and checked by setETHPoly().
Private ETHPoly ethPoly, external contract instance used for balanceOf/dividendsOf/withdraw/liquidate calls.
constructor() public, sets deployer = msg.sender and pushes the 12 hardcoded target addresses.
receive() external payable, accepts plain ETH transfers into the contract.
setETHPoly(ETHPoly) external, requires msg.sender == deployer and overwrites the ethPoly instance.
process() public, calls ethPoly.withdraw() when dividends exist and forwards the entire balance to splitter.
vote() external, marks the caller as voted and, at quorum, calls ethPoly.liquidate then process() and _resetVotes().
unvote() external, clears the caller's vote flag after a require(voted(msg.sender)) check.
totalVotes() public view, counts how many entries of targets are currently voted.
voted(address) public view, returns votes[_user].
_resetVotes() internal, clears the vote flag of every address in targets.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment, authorization checks and vote bookkeeping.
External call ethPoly.withdraw() executed inside process(); interacts with an arbitrary ETHPoly implementation.
address.transfer(_balance) sending the entire contract balance to the hardcoded splitter address.
External call ethPoly.liquidate(amount) executed inside vote() before vote state is reset.
Arithmetic expression ethPoly.balanceOf(address(this)) * LIQUIDATION_PERCENT / 100 sizing the liquidation amount.
Parameter of setETHPoly, the new ETHPoly instance assigned to the ethPoly state variable.
Parameter of voted(address), the address whose vote flag is read.
Local uint256 in process() holding address(this).balance before it is forwarded.
Local uint256 in totalVotes() accumulating the number of voted targets.
Loop index uint256 used by totalVotes() and _resetVotes() to walk the targets array.

edges.reason: constructor assigns deployer = msg.sender, giving the caller privileged ownership.
setETHPoly gates execution with require(msg.sender == deployer).
deployer state variable is read in the authorization check of setETHPoly.
setETHPoly overwrites the ethPoly instance later used for external calls.
constructor pushes the 12 hardcoded addresses into targets.
vote() indexes the votes mapping with msg.sender.
vote() writes votes[msg.sender] = true.
unvote() indexes the votes mapping with msg.sender.
unvote() writes votes[msg.sender] = false.
vote() calls totalVotes() to evaluate the quorum condition.
vote() compares totalVotes() against MIN_VOTES.
totalVotes() calls voted() for each entry of targets.
totalVotes() iterates over the targets array.
totalVotes() indirectly reads the votes mapping through voted().
voted() reads votes[_user] from the votes mapping.
_resetVotes() iterates over the targets array.
_resetVotes() clears the votes flag of every target.
vote() invokes process() once the quorum is reached.
vote() invokes _resetVotes() after the liquidation path.
vote() triggers the untrusted external call ethPoly.liquidate before votes are reset.
liquidate is dispatched on the ethPoly instance held in state.
process() reads ethPoly.dividendsOf(address(this)) from the ethPoly instance.
process() performs the untrusted external call ethPoly.withdraw().
withdraw is dispatched on the ethPoly instance held in state.
process() forwards the full balance to splitter via an external transfer.
ETH accepted by receive() becomes the balance that process() forwards to splitter.
local _balance is the value passed to splitter.transfer.
LIQUIDATION_PERCENT is a multiplicand in the liquidation amount computation.
ethPoly.balanceOf result is multiplied by LIQUIDATION_PERCENT and divided by 100.
computed amount is passed as the argument of ethPoly.liquidate.
_ethPoly parameter is assigned to the ethPoly state variable.
_user parameter is used by voted() to index the votes mapping.
_count local accumulates the number of matching targets in totalVotes().
loop index i walks the targets array in totalVotes() and _resetVotes().

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter only carries the new ETHPoly instance into the setETHPoly function body and is immediately stored; fold it into setETHPoly.
The parameter is only used to index the votes mapping inside voted(address); fold it into the voted getter.
The local only holds address(this).balance and is consumed by the splitter.transfer unsafe operation; fold it into that transfer.
The local is a pure accumulator used solely inside totalVotes(); fold it into that function.
The loop index only drives iteration over the targets array inside totalVotes()/_resetVotes(); fold it into the totalVotes loop structure.
